verdict.rationale: Analytics is a fair question for an MCP registry and connection platform like Smithery, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents usage dashboards, call-volume metrics, per-user stats, error tracking, or cost reporting for consumed or published servers. Per the shutdown notice, the Smithery API, Connect, accounts and CLI have also been discontinued.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see usage analytics for the servers and tools my org consumes or publishes — call volumes, users, errors, and cost
